title: Commercial Analyst
description:
Steamships Logistics under Steamships Trading Company is seeking an experienced, results-oriented professional to take on the role of Commercial Analyst. This pivotal position is responsible to take on full ownership of the pricing
discipline across Steamships Logistics [primarily Consort Express Lines and East West Transport], ensuring that every rate we offer, from ad hoc jobs to long-term contracts, is market-aligned, commercially justified, and strategically sound.
As a Commercial Analyst, you will:
Drive the end-to-end pricing strategy.
Maintain and manage rate cards, developing pricing models grounded in market intelligence and competitive insights.
Collaborate closely with the Head of Sales & Marketing and General Managers to balance profitability, competitiveness, and speed to market.
Take accountability for all pricing decisions, ensuring they are strategically informed and commercially defensible.
If you are a strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset and a passion for driving results, this is an exciting opportunity to shape the pricing strategy for one of Papua New Guinea’s leading logistics providers.
Required Experience
Minimum of 2-5 years’ experience in commercial, financial, or analytical role.
Experience with ERP systems (e.g. cargowise) is desirable.

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of financial principles and business performance metrics.
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Detail-oriented and organized.
